question: Where is Project SeaCURE being piloted?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Weymouth**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• SeaCURE – the first marine carbon capture system in Europe.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Project SeaCURE** is a **UK-based pilot project** for carbon capture.

 
 
• 
 
It aims to **extract CO₂ directly from seawater**, enhancing the ocean's **natural carbon absorption** capacity.

 
 
• 
 
The project is being conducted in **Weymouth**, UK.

 
 
• 
 
**Funded by the UK government**, it explores a **cost-effective, scalable** method to reduce **atmospheric CO₂**.

 
 
• 
 
It differs from traditional methods which capture CO₂ **from emissions or directly from the air**.

 
 
• 
 
Oceans hold **up to 150 times more carbon** than the atmosphere.

 
 
• 
 
SeaCURE uses **sustainable materials** for its operations.

 
 
• 
 
The goal is to **capture CO₂ before it escapes into the atmosphere**, helping to **combat climate change**.
